mentions.name: Shelvica
mentions.description: A personal library management service for cataloging large physical book collections.
mentions.problem: Most library management applications are either focused on ebooks or choke with a personal library of around 1,800 books; the author wanted more than Libib offers.
mentions.audience: The author and their wife, managing a personal library of around 1,800 books.
mentions.source_excerpt: Mostly because I’m working on a personal library management service called Shelvica to solve my own problems[1], and none of those services provided all the information on a book.

evidence.value: Mostly because I’m working on a personal library management service called Shelvica to solve my own problems[1], and none of those services provided all the information on a book.
